title: THG-Omni: Traceable Human-Centric Graph Supervision for Video Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.07836v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Omni-modal models can answer questions about video, but their predictions rarely show which participant, event, or interval supports an answer. Moreover, answer-level supervision alone does not teach a model to interpret structured video evidence. To systematically mitigate this issue, we present THG-Omni, a human-centric graph-supervision framework that links Segment Anything Model~3 participant tracks with temporally grounded Qwen3-VL annotations. Candidate semantic claims are checked against the source video and available audio before they are used to construct training questions, while track geometry provides explicit spatial and temporal supervision. The resulting questions teach an omni-modal reasoning model to interpret participant attributes, actions, affect, interactions, and their timing from a structured graph. translated_title: THG-Omni：面向视频推理的可追溯以人为中心图监督框架
translated_abstract: 全模态模型能够回答关于视频的问题，但其预测很少展示出是哪个参与者、事件或时间段支撑了答案。此外，仅依靠答案级别的监督无法教会模型解读结构化的视频证据。为了系统地缓解这一问题，我们提出了THG-Omni，这是一个以人为中心的图监督框架，它将Segment Anything Model 3的参与者追踪与具有时间定位的Qwen3-VL标注相连接。候选语义声明在被用于构建训练问题之前，会先对照源视频和可用音频进行核验，同时追踪几何信息提供了显式的空间和时间监督。由此产生的训练问题教会全模态推理模型从结构化图中解读参与者的属性、动作、情感、交互及其时间关系。在推理阶段，THG-Omni使用从评估视频构建的预测图。在IntentBench上的实验表明...
tldr: THG-Omni提出了一种以人为中心的可追溯图监督框架，通过将SAM3参与者追踪与时间定位的Qwen3-VL标注相结合并核验语义声明，使全模态推理模型能够从结构化图中解读视频里人物的属性、动作、情感、交互及其时间关系。
en_tdlr: THG-Omni is a human-centric, traceable graph-supervision framework that couples SAM3 participant tracks with temporally grounded Qwen3-VL annotations, enabling omni-modal reasoning models to interpret participant attributes, actions, affect, interactions, and timing from structured video graphs.
